record_identity.title: Zoetis Vetscan Imagyst allegedly misclassified canine cancer, followed by repeat surgery and death

incident_identity.historical_event_name: Zoetis Vetscan Imagyst allegedly misclassified canine cancer, followed by repeat surgery and death
incident_identity.date_basis: Reporting places the occurrence in October 2025; 1 October is retained only as an approximate month anchor.

summary: A veterinary hospital reportedly used Zoetis Vetscan Imagyst to analyse a dog's rapidly growing neck mass; the system allegedly classified it as inflammatory, while later pathology found aggressive cancer. The hospital alleges the first surgery was insufficient, a second surgery followed, and the dog died from complications.
